title.value: Context is the Key: Backdoor Attacks for In-Context Learning with Vision Transformers

TLDR.value: ViTs can be backdoored to behave maliciously during in-context learning for image tasks (even unseen tasks). Attackers can poison pretrained models to cause up to 13× performance drops or unwanted image transformations when triggered.

primary_area.value: other topics in machine learning (i.e., none of the above)
